name: dreamcontext Settings › Recall: switching from Hybrid to Raw

steps.label: Recall section, default mode
expect: The Recall section of Settings is displayed with its recall-mode options visible
The Hybrid option is the currently selected recall mode
The Hybrid option is marked as recommended
The user can pick between at least three recall modes
reject: The Raw option is the currently selected recall mode
The Hybrid option is marked as experimental
A recall option that has a cloud LLM pick the docs is shown
A GitHub token input field is visible on this screen
An error message is currently displayed

steps.label: Recall section, after choosing Raw
expect: The Raw option is the currently selected recall mode
The Hybrid option explains that it falls back to BM25 until the embedding model and index are ready
The Hybrid option mentions a one-time model download of roughly 113 MB
reject: The Hybrid option is the currently selected recall mode
A GitHub token input field is visible on this screen
An error message is currently displayed
